sections.label: Specialist accounting, built around who you are
text: Specialist accounting, built around who you are
We don't try to be everything to everyone. Every service below is shaped around the four types of client we understand best.
SMEs & Limited Companies
Annual accounts, corporation tax, payroll, VAT and management information that helps you actually run the business — not just report on it.
Contractors & Freelancers
IR35 assessments, dividend planning, expense guidance and same-day company formations, so you keep more of what you earn.
Landlords & Property Investors
Section 24 planning, incorporation advice, CGT on disposals, and portfolio-level tax strategy for one property or fifty.
High-Earning Individuals
Self-assessment, pension and allowance planning, tapering mitigation and personal tax strategy for those in the higher and additional rate bands.
What We Do

sections.label: Switching accountants in four simple steps
text: Switching accountants in four simple steps
We handle the admin of moving from your current accountant — it typically takes less than two weeks and requires almost nothing from you.
Free consultation
We learn about your business or personal situation and give you a clear, fixed quote on the spot.
We contact your old accountant
With your authorisation, we request professional clearance and transfer your records — no awkward conversations for you.
Onboarding & setup
We get you set up on cloud software if you're not already, and agree your reporting and deadline schedule.
Ongoing support
Regular check-ins, proactive tax planning, and a real person who picks up the phone when you call.

sections.label: Common questions
text: Common questions
Do I need to be based near Manchester to work with you?
Not at all. Around 70% of our clients work with us entirely remotely — by phone, video call and cloud software — from across England, Scotland and Wales.
How long does switching accountants take?
Typically 10–14 days. We handle professional clearance with your current accountant and manage the transfer of records, so it requires very little from you.
Are your fees really fixed, with no hidden extras?
Yes. We agree your fee upfront based on your specific circumstances, and it won't change unless your circumstances materially change — we'll always discuss that with you first.
Do you help with IR35 and contractor status?
Yes, this is one of our core specialisms. We review contracts, assess status, and advise on the most tax-efficient way to operate as a contractor under current legislation.
Can you help landlords decide whether to incorporate?
Yes. We model the tax impact of holding property personally versus through a limited company, factoring in Section 24, CGT, and stamp duty, so you can make an informed decision.
What software do you use?
We're certified partners for Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent, and we're happy to work with whichever platform suits you best — or recommend one if you're starting fresh.
